name: finding_add
description: Save a finding/evidence note as a durable session artifact (persisted to disk). Use during reversing to bookmark endpoints, auth flows, secrets, or vulnerabilities. Markdown body supported. Back the claim with `evidenceIds` (requestIds and/or other finding ids) and a `reproCommand`; a finding stays `candidate` until it carries ≥2 independent evidence items (best: 1 static + 1 dynamic), at which point you may mark it `validated`.

body.description: Markdown body — observations, payload, repro, etc.

category.description: What kind of finding this is (groups the export report)

evidenceIds.description: requestIds and/or other finding ids that back this claim (the evidence chain)

reproCommand.description: Exact command/script that reproduces the claim (e.g. an export_python_client path)

status.description: Defaults to candidate. `validated` requires ≥2 independent evidence items.

name: finding_export
description: Render findings as a structured Markdown report — the session deliverable. Split into Confirmed (validated facts), Needs verification (unproven suspicions to check before acting), and Attack surface & recon (endpoint inventory, compact). Defaults to the current page's site so one scan's report is not polluted by findings from other targets; pass site=<url> when no tab is active (e.g. from a finished scan), or all=true for every finding in the store.

site.description: URL of the scanned site — use when the page/tab is gone so the report stays scoped

all.description: Include findings from every site, not just the current page's

name: redteam_start
description: Launch a site-wide Red Team scan of one target URL: opens up to N same-site pages as background tabs, runs one inspecting agent per tab in parallel (read + dynamic exploration), then (at probe/redteam intensity) single-shot probes against the deduped endpoint set, and finishes with a merged Markdown report. By default the user confirms the run in the Red Team popup — active intensities are never started silently. Pass start:true to run the whole pipeline without a click; this is honoured ONLY for loopback targets (localhost/127.x/::1 — your own machine), matching the network fence, so the agent can self-drive local benchmarks. Non-loopback targets ignore start:true and still wait for the human click. Use this instead of spawning sub-agents per tab. Poll progress with finding_list / list_requests; the final report is exported by finding_export.

url.description: Absolute start URL of the site to scan (scheme required)

intensity.description: readonly = observe only; probe = replay captured requests unchanged + security headers; redteam = additionally one mutated/payload request per endpoint (default readonly)

start.description: Run the full pipeline immediately without the user click. Honoured only for loopback targets (localhost/127.x/::1); ignored otherwise.

name: scope_status
description: Show the active target scope. When enabled, navigate/replay/repeater/intruder/burst refuse hosts outside these registrable domains. Empty = no enforcement (all hosts allowed).

name: scope_set
description: Set the target scope to the given hosts/URLs (stored as registrable domains, so subdomains like api./cdn. are included). Pass no hosts to scope to the current tab. Replaces any existing scope.

hosts.description: Hosts or URLs. Omit to use the current tab host.

name: scope_add
description: Add hosts/URLs to the current scope (registrable domains).

name: scope_clear
description: Clear the scope (disables enforcement — all hosts allowed again).

name: lab_target
description: Mark EXTRA (non-loopback) hosts as disposable LAB targets so the capture-not-send fence steps aside for them: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE pass through to the real server instead of being answered with a synthetic 204, letting the red team CONFIRM mutation-only vulns (SSTI, SQLi/cmd-injection via POST) instead of stopping at "candidate". Loopback (localhost / 127.x / ::1) is ALREADY a lab target by default, so you only need this for a non-loopback host you own and are authorized to mutate (e.g. an authorized staging domain). Pass no hosts to use the current tab; pass clear:true to drop the extra hosts.

hosts.description: Hosts or URLs. Omit to use the current tab host.

clear.description: Clear all lab targets (re-fence every host).
